Support roadmap for AI initiatives and implementation. Identify and mitigate risks associated with data quality issues that could lead to MRP failures or supply chain disruptions. Provide ongoing support and training to stakeholders on analytics practices and tools. Monitor and report on data quality metrics, implementing corrective actions as necessary. Proven experience in supply chain processes. Strong understanding of MRP systems and data management principles. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels. Knowledge of supply planning processes and inventory management principles. WE VALUE Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Supply Chain Certifications such as CSCP / CPIM / CPSM / Lean Six Sigma. Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL. Familiarity with advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and machine learning.
